svg.title: Desert recovery decision tree
svg.desc: Recovery checklist for unclear quest bait, failed Pufferfish attempts, missing Fin, and absent Rocks marker.
svg.text: Use the current objective as your source of truth

g.text: Reopen NPC dialogue; read current objective text.
Back off at the phase change; use ranged windows.
Search arena and inventory before spending again.
Complete the accepted hand-in; then check Radar.

svg.text: Optional Blue Shark collection does not replace the Pufferfish story step.
